validation: Component tests with known positive/negative CFO ramps, constant carrier, rejected measurements, bound/fallback and association faults

limitations: Three-repeat basin diagnostic is not the required four-repeat resolver.
Per-pilot phase/frequency search is post-hoc and does not establish causal tracking or calibrate a gate.

causal_C_replay.limitation: Only the retained initial eight pilot windows are available; no later catch-up or current-time handoff is inferred.
